price_reference.note: Market capitalization is calculated from the retained common-share denominator; the preferred-share claim is modeled separately.

ttm_diagnostics.note: OCF-PPE is a diagnostic only. It is not normalized owner FCF because working capital, intangible/R&D cash investment, acquisitions and expansion economics are not fully normalized.

reverse_expectations.method: Retain the 2026-09-06 Base year-1 revenue KRW0.78T, owner-margin path 22% to 25%, 22x terminal multiple, 10% required return and KRW0.207259T preferred redemption claim; solve one uniform revenue growth rate for years 2-10 that matches the September 10 common-share price. This is a stress representation, not a uniquely observable market belief.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: About 4.53% annual revenue growth for nine years after a KRW0.78T year-1 revenue base is materially less demanding than the prior 5.90% reverse case and does not require a Bull-only operating path. The larger uncertainty is whether 22-25% owner margins and the preferred-claim treatment are durable.

bear.narrative: REJURAN growth normalizes, international sell-through underwhelms, competition/regulatory costs rise, owner margin settles near 17% and a stressed preferred cash claim is recognized.

base.narrative: International REJURAN and cosmetics expansion continues, growth normalizes over a decade, mature owner margin reaches 25%, and the current preferred liability is treated as a redemption claim.

bull.narrative: REJURAN becomes a durable global category leader, cosmetics/localization scale, capacity ramps at high returns and owner margin approaches 30% with long growth duration.

two_state_price_position.note: Algebraic price location only; not an estimated probability.

preferred_rights_sensitivity.primary_method: Redemption-claim method retained for scenario comparability: use 10.389648M common shares and deduct the preferred claim once.
preferred_rights_sensitivity.alternate_conversion_method: Remove the KRW0.207259T Base redemption claim before adding 1.175647M one-for-one conversion shares.
preferred_rights_sensitivity.note: The redemption claim and conversion dilution are mutually exclusive alternatives for this diagnostic; they are not stacked.

operating_overlay.plant5: 2027 raw-material / 2028 cosmetics completion targets; >8x pharma raw, >5x medical-device raw, >10x cosmetics capacity targets are management plans, not realized economics.
operating_overlay.europe: Five-year KRW88B VIVACY framework covers 22 countries; revenue is recognized only as actual product is sold, not added separately to DCF.
operating_overlay.cg_usa: Acquisition terms undisclosed; strategic localization evidence only until purchase accounting and realized cash returns are available.

valuation_conclusion: At KRW349,500, the stock trades roughly 45% below the retained Base value and the reverse case requires only about 4.53% annual growth in years 2-10 under retained Base economics. Expectation gap is favorable, but buy authorization remains blocked by unresolved preferred-share rights/dilution, post-expansion incremental ROIC and flagship-brand concentration.
